vulnerabilities.description: gets() reads input from stdin until a newline or EOF without any bounds checking.
vulnerabilities.possible_consequences: Arbitrary code execution, stack smashing, crash via segmentation fault.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Replace with fgets(buffer, sizeof(buffer), stdin) to enforce bounded reading.
vulnerabilities.safer_code: if (fgets(buffer, sizeof(buffer), stdin) == NULL) { /* handle error */ }
vulnerabilities.cwe_id: CWE-120: Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input
